title: Rapid staple coverage ledger
content:
Purpose: quick, transplantable ledger to surface small coverage gaps and single-day ownership handoffs across SRE / Platform / Product teams. Not intended to replace the main rota — just a fast, portable snapshot for ad-hoc coverage asks and micro-surges.

How to use: paste this sheet into an owner’s working doc, update status/ETA in-line, ping the Slack thread in Notes, and close rows once the follow-up ticket is created. Rows are intentionally terse.

Columns: Item | Owner | Priority | Region | Status | ETA | Follow-up ticket | Notes / Slack thread

Rows:
1. "Regional fallback test — us-west-2" | Marco Reynolds | high | us-west-2 | in-progress | 2028-11-03 | JIRA-OPS-9091 | quick smoke + runbook tweak; see #infra-fallback (link)
2. "Embedding cache warm-up for sales demo" | Lena Kim | medium | global | blocked | 2028-11-05 | (TBD) | waiting on dedicated pool resize; raised resize request in PR-312
3. "Quickburst capacity check for EU promo" | Devon Ortiz | high | eu-central | pending | 2028-11-04 | JIRA-OPS-9093 | need headcount for manual surge; possible borrow from dedicated on-call
4. "Prefix cache eviction audit (sample)" | Aisha Patel | low | global | done | 2028-11-02 | CON-1130 | ran 20-sample audit, one mismatch — added note to CON-1130
5. "Lightweight throttling sanity sweep" | Marco Reynolds | medium | ap-south-1 | pending | 2028-11-06 | (TBD) | quick check during low-traffic window; no customer impact expected

Quick totals (for this snapshot):
- Open high-priority rows: 2
- Blocked: 1
- Rows with follow-up tickets: 2/5

Open questions / loose ends:
- Which team signs off on temporary dedicated pool borrows for demos? (product-ops vs platform-engineering)
- Do we want an explicit expiry for ledger entries older than 72 hours? propose auto-close / refile to backlog.

Action items (owners tagged inline):
- Marco: finish fallback smoke and update JIRA-OPS-9091 with runbook steps (ETA 11/03).
- Lena: confirm resize timeline with cloud infra and tag PR-312 for review (ETA 11/05).
- Devon: source manual surge headcount and confirm weekend coverage (ETA 11/04).
- Aisha: reconcile sample audit into CON-1130 and add a one-paragraph summary for ops-deck.

Notes to reviewers: this is intentionally compact and meant to be copied into a team’s daily stand-up doc. If you need a more formal tracker, move items into the capacity playbook spreadsheet (link in CON-1129).

History / context: spawned from the Nov 1 ops postmortem where small cross-region promo impacts required a quick stand-up of temporary handoffs. Use-case is short-lived, high-velocity coordination — not long-term record-keeping.

Slack anchor: #ops-rapid (see thread t/2028-11-02-rapid-staple)

Last edit notes: added row 3 after morning sync; Lena flagged the resize blocker and I added PR-312 link.

-- end ledger snapshot --
